method: create an accepted session on the eval serve -> stop the serve (supervisor reaps chrome) -> start a fresh serve on the SAME state dir -> verify the session record survived and the restarted serve reconciled it

afterRestart.recoveryLog: [lifecycle] reconciled 1 persisted executions; 0 handed to the original suspension recovery

notes: durable-accept proven three ways: on-disk aside session record retained across the restart; the restarted serve's lifecycle reconciled 1 persisted execution; GET /sessions/:id returns the record with a resolved (done) status. (A separate listAsideSessions probe used a wrong route path and was inconclusive; the three proofs above stand.)
